description: Memi skill registry — audited frontend default and optional reference guidance

skills.name: memoire-design-tooling
skills.description: Audited 2.8 beta frontend context and static inspection workflow.

skills.name: SUPERPOWER
skills.description: Historical workflow reference; inactive in 2.8 beta.

skills.name: /figma-use
skills.description: Optional reference; external tools require separate host authorization. Foundational Figma canvas skill — MCP tool decision tree, Auto Layout, variables, self-healing loop, Code Connect. Load before any /figma-* skill.

skills.name: /figma-generate-design
skills.description: Optional reference; external tools require separate host authorization. Create new screens and pages using existing components and design tokens. Prefers use_figma for design-aware writes.

skills.name: /figma-generate-library
skills.description: Optional reference; external tools require separate host authorization. Create Figma component library from codebase with Code Connect parity. Uses batch operations for speed.

skills.name: /figma-audit
skills.description: Audit design system for consistency, accessibility, token adoption, and Code Connect coverage. Read-only analysis with scored report.

skills.name: UX Tenets and Traps
skills.description: First-class UX critique framework for tenet coverage, trap risk, screenshot audits, and recommended tweaks.

skills.name: /figma-prototype
skills.description: Optional reference; external tools require separate host authorization. Create interactive prototypes with flows, transitions, and user journey mapping. Generates standalone HTML prototype.

skills.name: /multi-agent
skills.description: Optional reference; external tools require separate host authorization. Parallel agent orchestration with box widgets, coordinated handoffs, and error recovery across ports 9223-9232.

skills.name: Atomic Design
skills.description: Complete Atomic Design methodology reference — atoms through pages, token architecture, component API design, shadcn/ui mappings.

skills.name: Dashboard from Research
skills.description: Optional reference; external tools require separate host authorization. Transform research data (Excel, CSV, stickies) into interactive dashboards with dataviz specs and generated code.

skills.name: Design Extract
skills.description: Optional reference; external tools require separate host authorization. Extract any website's design system from its public URL — colors, typography, spacing, shadows, component patterns. Outputs DESIGN.md with Tailwind config.

skills.name: Build SwiftUI Interface
skills.description: Apple-platform implementation guidance; Memi ios commands are unavailable in 2.8 beta.

activationContexts.design-extraction: Extracting design systems from URLs or websites
